# Four Hundred Forty-Seven

<margin>
Perfection of Wisdom, One Hundred Twenty-Two, Four Hundred Forty-Seven, Protective Shield <note>The marginal text indicates the title, volume number, page number, and section</note>.
</margin>

By the <term>Bodhisattva</term> <gloss>enlightenment being</gloss> <term>Mahasattva</term> <gloss>great being</gloss>, in the <term>Prajnaparamita</term> <gloss>Perfection of Wisdom</gloss>,
it is thus performed; in the Perfection of Wisdom it is thus performed,
in the root of the verses it is thus performed; in the root of the verses
it is thus performed, they do not see it as thus performed,
by not seeing they do not see, by not seeing they do not see,
they do not see it as not seeing, by not seeing they do not see,
they do not see it as not seeing, by not seeing they do not see,
they do not see it as not seeing, by not seeing they do not see,
they do not see it as not seeing, by not seeing they do not see,

they do not see it as not seeing, by not seeing they do not see,
